Letter of Representation
5-6-25
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1415
Our client: David Smith
Date of loss: 4-20-25
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the head-on collision described in your
file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication
regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.
We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with the declarations
page and a statement of any other coverage that may apply, including umbrella or excess policies. Please confirm receipt of this
request in writing.
We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes vehicle data and event recorder
information, photographs, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, telematics records, and any communications with
the insured or third parties. Routine destruction or altreation of these materials should be suspended until the claim is fully
resolved.
Our client intends to pursue full compensation for medical expenses, lost income, and pain and suffering. We look forward to
your prompt response.
Sincerely,
Jennifer Black
Montoya & Solis Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
